19576.title: One Piece: The Movie
19576.overview: There once was a pirate known as the Great Gold Pirate Woonan, who obtained almost one-third of the world's gold. Over the course of a few years, the pirate's existence faded, and a legend grew that he disappeared with his gold to a remote island, an island pirates continue to search for. Aboard the Going Merry, Luffy and his crew, starved and reckless, are robbed of their treasure. In an attempt to get it back, they wreck the getaway ship, guided by a young boy named Tobio, who's a captured part of El Drago's pirate crew. El Drago's love for gold has driven him to look for Woonan's island, and thanks to Woonan's treasure map, he finds it. During this time, Luffy's crew have been split up, and despite their own circumstances, they must find a way to stop El Drago from obtaining Woonan's gold.

621304.title: Children of Blood and Bone
621304.overview: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

977976.title: Mayamrigaya
977976.overview: The film is based on Rabindranath Tagore's novel Dui Bon which was first published in 1933 and is among one of Tagore's last three works.

1058424.title: Hope
1058424.overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

1084728.title: Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
1084728.overview: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Romans attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

1085176.title: Demons
1085176.overview: In the 1990s, Slavik, a homeless drifter from Russia with a blurred past, wanders into a remote village in central Ukraine. Nina, a strong and independent woman much older than him takes the stranger into her home. At first, their strange companionship resembles an unlikely love story. But as their relationship unfolds, love turns into betrayal, and the village begins to reveal its hidden rules: a place where witches may live next door and the dead sometimes speak with the living.

1152312.title: My Wife Cries
1152312.overview: A normal working day on a construction site. Thomas, a 40-year-old crane operator, receives a call from his wife asking him to pick her up from the hospital. He finds her crying.

1224440.title: Smart Working
1224440.overview: The story follows Giuliano, whose life has improved thanks to his working from home, but his colleagues’ poor performance threatens to force everyone back to the office. Meanwhile, he and his wife, Laura, are expecting a second child and are looking for a bigger home. As Laura makes up her mind about a controversial job offer, Giuliano’s co-workers turn their flat into a makeshift office, rekindling their efficiency and organisation. Amid intrusive co-workers and domestic chaos, Giuliano will have to find creative solutions to save his job, his family and the dream of a new home.

1249208.title: Hungry
1249208.overview: A high school wrestling coach must overcome addictive behavior in ordere to lead his team to a championship.

1259256.title: Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost
1259256.overview: A horror story about keeping in touch with your high school friends.

1289720.title: Pok Ame Ame
1289720.overview: Tells the story of a child who was left in a disabled state after a brutal murder killed her entire family while on vacation at a villa. After that, the girl suddenly gained mystical powers and made her seek revenge against everyone who was considered to be related to the murder case, including the teenagers, one of whom turned out to be the killer.

1302904.title: Practical Magic 2
1302904.overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

1329016.title: Tony
1329016.overview: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

1337592.title: Erupcja
1337592.overview: While on vacation in Poland, Bethany breaks away from a romantic itinerary planned by her doting boyfriend, Rob, fearing that a marriage proposal is imminent. Reuniting instead with an old friend, Nel, the two women rekindle a uniquely combustible chemistry over the course of a few days in a chaste but burning trust predicated on sapphic synchronicity and a mutual penchant for poetry.

1368376.title: Berlin Kills Me
1368376.overview: Jacky (30), who lives in Berlin, falls into a deep void after the death of her mother and losing her job. Unable to succeed in her attempt to commit suicide, she decides to hire a hitman. Unbeknownst to her, she meets Çello (33), the killer assigned to commit murder. Çello and Jacky fall in love with each other. The loving couple decides to go into hiding, but their happiness doesn’t last long. A major confrontation takes place at Madam Bora’s Pissoir Bar.

1370424.title: He's Watching You
1370424.overview: When a string of murders rocks his quiet town, a teen's search for answers leads him to a hidden stash of VHS tapes that may contain clues to solve the mystery of the serial killer known only as "The Pill."

1372280.title: Verónica
1372280.overview: In the midst of gender transition, Verónica runs away from home in search of a new beginning and finds refuge with her cousin Alex. As she navigates her new life, actress Israel, who plays Verónica, faces her own personal journey during filming.

1404472.title: Signals
1404472.overview: Plot TBA. Described by Dupieux as “an experiment, an artistic happening” about the medium of television.

1408696.title: Lorie Party 2026 au cinéma
1408696.overview: Lorie invites you to a colorful and festive evening! Hear all her greatest hits during her Lorie Party 2025/2026 tour!

1425784.title: Animol
1425784.overview: Behind the walls of a young offender institution, Troy is thrust into a brutal world of gangs, loyalty and violence from the moment he arrives. When an unspoken bond develops with a fellow inmate, it becomes a dangerous vulnerability for them.

1426296.title: wabi_
1426296.overview: Trapped in his nostalgia and haunted by the impermanence of things, a sad little ghost is unable to pass through the liminal space he occupies.

1427128.title: KikoRiki: Through the Universes
1427128.overview: Krosh and the Hedgehog find an unusual device in Chamomile Valley that takes them into a game about the future, where they are ordinary children on a spaceship flying to Mars. Adventures begin when the characters realize that this is not a game at all.

1427576.title: A Time in Eternity
1427576.overview: A woman embarks on an unyielding and possibly hopeless search for her missing husband, a journey that strains her already fragile relationship with her daughter. Along the way, she also faces the unwelcome advances of her persistent brother-in-law.

1430968.title: Idiotka
1430968.overview: In West Hollywood’s Russian district, Margarita lives out the American Dream: competing on a reality show. Will she slay, serve, or survive?

1437240.title: Playground
1437240.overview: A lonely teenage girl joins a school for promising killers and trains hard to become an professional assassin as she uncovers the mysteries of her parents' death.

1438392.title: Euphoria
1438392.overview: A young woman and her family seek justice after she is raped by a group of young men who come from powerful and influential backgrounds.

1444088.title: Pluto
1444088.overview: Follows the unexpected arrival of an extraterrestrial visitor in a quiet Kerala village, which turns everyday life completely upside down.
1444088.trailerName: PLUTO Movie - Teaser / Neeraj Madhav / Althaf Salim / Shamal Chacko / O

1449400.title: Reckless
1449400.overview: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

1461432.title: Adult Supervision
1461432.overview: Three fathers accompany their teenage daughters on a school trip to a remote island. What begins as a peaceful getaway soon turns into a series of unexpected problems. Each father has a different approach to parenting, influenced by his own past experiences, and their conflicting views create tension among them. As the situation becomes increasingly difficult to control, memories of their past return and force them to confront their mistakes and shortcomings. The trip ultimately leaves them questioning who is really in control.

1462584.title: As Dez Vantagens de Morrer Depois de Você

1465784.title: Jimmy & The Demons
1465784.overview: In this charming and profound portrait of artistic devotion, celebrated sculptor James Grashow embarks, at age 79, on a four year odyssey to complete his magnum opus: a gigantic, intricate wooden sculpture dubbed "The Cathedral."

1471224.title: Murder in the Building
1471224.overview: Misanthropic novelist François writes gripping crime stories – “Agatha Christie meets The Scarlet Pimpernel” – but outside of the swashbuckling imaginary world of his Marquis la Rose-novels, life is far from thrilling. His partner Colette, a professor at the Sorbonne and world-renowned expert on Alfred Hitchcock, is tired of watching François sit around their apartment in his pyjamas and yearns for the excitement of the classic films she watches with her students. When Colette begins to suspect their flamboyant actor neighbour of murdering his wife, the couple’s mundane lives are turned upside down – and their stale relationship is jolted back to life.

1471672.title: The Fall of Sir Douglas Weatherford
1471672.overview: In the Scottish village of Arberloch, Kenneth, a grieving tour guide, is devoted to preserving the legacy of the town's sole historical figure—eighteenth-century inventor Sir Douglas Weatherford. But when a fantasy series chooses Arberloch as its filming location, and the town turns its back on Weatherford in favour of fan culture, Kenneth descends into madness.
1471672.trailerName: THE FALL OF SIR DOUGLAS WEATHERFORD | Official Trailer | In Cinemas June 12

1473592.title: Midnight Girls
1473592.overview: Set in Nagoya, Japan, four Filipina entertainers form a sisterhood while facing the emotional cost of their jobs. Together, they must decide what they are truly willing to sacrifice for their dreams in a foreign land.
1473592.trailerName: Midnight Girls (2026) Official Teaser - Sanya Lopez, Loisa Andalio, Jane Oineza & Jodi Sta. Maria

1473784.title: Bunker
1473784.overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

1475768.title: Maatrubhumi
1475768.overview: Based on the events that took place between the Indian and Chinese troops at the Galwan region on June 15, 2020 when 200 Indian soldiers bravely defended their territory against a force of 1200 Chinese Liberation Army soldiers

1481336.title: Night After Night
1481336.overview: A reclusive night guard at a private university investigates the circumstances surrounding a coworker’s disappearance and a secret room in which an ever changing entity reappears night after night.

1482168.title: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
1482168.overview: Explore the formative years of the Red Hot Chili Peppers and the profound influence of original bandmate Hillel Slovak.

1487864.title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
1487864.overview: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

1488184.title: Касса невест
1488184.overview: A near future where people can travel through time-though only a select few. Lavrik, a charming con man and gigolo, has been exposed and left without a source of income. The only way for the hero to improve his situation is to fulfill a task assigned by the billionaire Boltzmann and travel back in time to retrieve the Hymen Cup. Lavrik is transported to Moscow in 1913 and begins hunting for an artifact located in the Bridal Cashier's Office, a bank where dowries are accumulated. But Varya, a principled woman who is also a member of the Cashier's Office and has a keen sense of deception, seeks to ruin Lavrik's plans. Lavrik devises a plan to outwit Varya and, with her help, pull off the scam.

1496696.title: Breeder
1496696.overview: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

1497464.title: Gatto
1497464.overview: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, a scrappy black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, a ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose — unless Venice gets the better of him first.

1511096.title: Life in Ukraine be like
1511096.overview: Oleg's painstaking search for freedom is interrupted by the sudden return of his ex-girlfriend back to Ukraine, calling into question Oleg's lifestyle in the context of the Russo-Ukrainian War.

1515704.title: Mascara
1515704.overview: After his wife's passing, an old man spends one last night in their home—before bidding an unforgettable farewell. Written & directed by Ahmed Said Ağaoğlu. In development.

1517368.title: In Lieu of Flowers
1517368.overview: In the wake of Megan's sudden passing, her best friends Frances and Taylor work together to honor her wishes to remove any contraband items from her bedroom in efforts to preserve her image to her mourning parents. Confronted by conflicting perceptions of Megan and approaches to grief, Frances and Taylor wrestle with the question: Will they remain friends without her?

1519672.title: The Devil at the Door
1519672.overview: When an ancient collective fear returns to a small town, a young man must face alone the horrors that lurk in his bedroom.

1520504.title: Memory of Princess Mumbi
1520504.overview: In 2093, filmmaker Kuve travels to Umata to document the aftermath of a war that revived ancient kingdoms. There, he meets Mumbi, who challenges him to make his film without the use of AI. As Kuve searches for his own voice, he begins to realize that even in a broken world, beauty can be found in the small human moments we often overlook.

1522680.title: A Portrait of Photography
1522680.overview: Japanese photojournalist Kuwabara Shisei boards a flight to Korea. Since his first visit in 1964 as a 27-year-old, Shisei has spent six decades documenting the turbulence of Korea's modern history: Cheonggyecheon, military camp towns, the Vietnam War deployment, and democracy movements. Now elderly, he returns, believing this might be his final journey. He carries a mission: to revisit the places and people that defined his life’s work. The film follows the photographer’s footsteps back into the heart of these historical sites.
1522680.trailerName: 사진의 얼굴 A Portrait of Photography | 한국경쟁 Korean Competition | 17TH DMZ Docs Trailer

1525560.title: Brunch for a Depressed Zombie
1525560.overview: One day, a wife suffering from depression turned into a zombie. However, instead of despairing, the husband begins developing strange yet lovely survival recipes to get through each day with his wife. Set against the backdrop of a quiet and mysterious rural village, the husband attempts extraordinary dishes to satisfy his wife's appetite and discovers a crucial hint in his late grandmother's old recipes.

1527288.title: D’un monde à l’autre
1527288.overview: From One World to Another is an intimate documentary, a human and sensory journey through grief and friendship. After the accidental death of his best friend, actor Jérémie Renier begins a journey of contemplation thanks to the encounter with a French explorer, Loury Lag, who travels through uninhabited territories in extreme conditions. They will set off together across the Arctic ice floes. Left to their own devices, the two men will test each other, until they become alive again. An initiatory quest, which explores the territories of life, where the hostility of the world refers to death.

1529400.title: Life Is
1529400.overview: Nora is about to turn 40 and can't stop wondering: what's the point of all this? What was meant to be a celebration turns into a series of unfortunate missteps that push her toward self-discovery. With open wounds, unspoken desires, and a burning past, Nora confronts her family history, death, unemployment, the collapse of her polyamorous relationship, and the urgent need to redefine love, her sexuality, and what she truly wants from life.

1529848.title: The Station
1529848.overview: As Layal runs a women-only fuel station in a segregated war-torn town, she is faced with her 12-year-old brother’s growing desire to break free and become a ‘man’. When Layal’s estranged sister unexpectedly shows up with a proposition for their brother, the siblings’ relationship is put to the test.

1541560.title: Stop! That! Train!
1541560.overview: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

1545976.title: Scenes of Friendly Ties
1545976.overview: One winter day and one night in the lives of thirty-year-old friends, former classmates. They must overcome everyday difficulties to meet and see off Sasha, who is leaving Moscow for an extended period.

1548472.title: Cantos Escuros 2: A Madição de Safira

1548664.title: Under the Red Light
1548664.overview: A documentary film about photographer Romualdas Požerskis.

1550392.title: My Plastic Mother
1550392.overview: Eki, living by the landfill, searches for a memento to honor his late mother. Battling the relentless rain, landslides, and looming threats from scavengers and machinery, he fears her memory could be lost beneath the waste forever.

1561144.title: Madhuvidhu
1561144.overview: When Amrutharaj, a groom from an all-male household repeatedly rejected by brides' families, falls in love with Sneha Marcose, their journey toward marriage ignites a chain of hilarious chaos inside his unruly home.

1561336.title: 2 Valid IDs
1561336.overview: A poor farmer, unable to claim a remittance because she lacks the required two valid IDs, finds herself in a situation that challenges her character, beliefs, and morality.

1568184.title: Paikar
1568184.overview: An Iranian expat journeys back to his homeland, where he must face his domineering father and grapple with complex emotions about family ties, cultural identity, and his place in the world.

1570488.title: A Dog’s Perfect Christmas
1570488.overview: Follows a family in crisis where a teenager, her grandfather, and his trusty basset hound struggle to keep the household together at Christmas.

1573688.title: Color Theories by Julio Torres. A Guide to Seeing the World
1573688.overview: Julio Torres takes the stage in NYC and invites the audience to see the people, places, and things around us through his kaleidoscopic lens. Blending stand-up, an interactive set, and live drawings, Julio explores the inherent traits, personalities, and emotions of particular colors.

1577592.title: Abysses and Wonders
1577592.overview: Christine’s father died when she was still a small child, and she remained in the care of her sadistic mother, who beat her and abused her psychologically. Christine is still convinced that her mother hid a farewell letter from her beloved father. Jean’s father committed suicide several years ago, and left behind a lengthy letter, but Jean never found the courage to read it. Together, Christine and Jean embark on a unique road trip across the French countryside to visit Christine’s mother, and try to confront the past.

1578488.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
1578488.overview: An amateur production of A Christmas Carol at a retirement home is reluctantly directed by reclusive man on community service.

1582328.title: Love At Last
1582328.overview: The funny story of Aslı, an advertising executive who doesn't want to be alone on Valentine's Day.

1587128.title: Kemet's Enigma
1587128.overview: An Archaeological Adventurer goes on a journey to find an ancient artifact that can change reality

1588472.title: L&O - Law and Order
1588472.overview: After losing his son to a drug empire, DYSP Balagopal joins four fearless recruits to take down the ruthless Pacha and his cartel. The return of legendary gangster Karikkamuri Shanmughan sets the stage for an explosive final showdown

1590456.title: Paradeisa
1590456.overview: Struggling to keep their family together, Lou helps her broke artist father fake his own death to boost the value of his work. But as the lie of cat litter ashes grows, she realises that letting go might be the only way forward.

1592312.title: Slay Day
1592312.overview: On Friday the 13th, 1987, in the picture-perfect town of Belle Falls, six teens prepare for their biggest night of the year: the Sadie Hawkins dance. But when the town exhumes the body of the real Sadie Hawkins to unravel the truth behind her killing spree fifty years earlier, a malevolent force returns to the town.

1593144.title: Four Itchy Boys
1593144.overview: Four young men quarantined for a unexplainable, unrelenting itch prepare for a live-stream press event to prove they’re not the monsters the world believes them to be. But behind the scenes, a ruthless producer is plotting a more grotesque spectacle.

1595128.title: Lure
1595128.overview: After being invited to a party by a mysterious and alluring woman, six men awake to find themselves part of a cult family's gruesome annual tradition to find the perfect suitor.

1596344.title: Rare Birds
1596344.overview: A trouble-making 12-year-old tries to convince her former camp counselor to ditch his dead-end job at the local antique store for one last game of basketball.

1599480.title: Pina
1599480.overview: Pina, a 62-year-old lawyer, is in denial about her increasing dementia and is desperate to convince her colleague that she can still work.

1606776.title: Trick
1606776.overview: Successful illustrator Daniele Mallarico travels to Naples to look after his four-year-old grand-son while his daughter is away for a few days. What begins as a simple babysitting job turns into a subtle psychological duel, as the child’s boundless imagination slowly unsettles him. Trapped together in the apartment, Daniele is forced to confront something far more disturbing than a mischievous child: the fear of aging and the loss of creativity. Through this strange encounter, he may rediscover the power of imagination he thought he had lost.

1610936.title: Haunted Universities 4
1610936.overview: The tales from four regions of Thailand. Stories handed down "from generation to generation" still told to this day: North – Northeast – Central – South.

1616184.title: I Understand Your Displeasure
1616184.overview: Heike works at a cleaning company, where every day she has to handle her team’s struggles, the pressure of delivering a spotless job, and the need to keep clients and boss happy. When a powerful subcontractor threatens to withdraw his support if she does not provide more work for his team, Heike faces a difficult choice. To comply, she must sacrifice one of her own employees. As the pressure closes in, Heike must decide how far she is willing to go to meet the job’s ruthless demands.
1616184.trailerName: I UNDERSTAND YOUR DISPLEASURE - Official Trailer

1618040.title: POSSESSION: The Darkness Within
1618040.overview: Odysseas Zervas, a grieving painter plagued by visions, confronts a sinister figure who mirrors his fears. As reality dissolves, his family seeks help, while a monk races to save him from a spiritual force that claims both sanity and soul.

1620280.title: Teeth of A Fawn
1620280.overview: Bea can’t breathe when her girlfriend’s away.

1623608.title: Ashes
1623608.overview: Lucila leaves Mexico with her younger brother to reunite with their mother in Madrid, who had left a few years earlier to chase a better future. When they finally arrive, the bitter, suffocating reality that awaits them proves far harsher than Lucila had imagined. Still, she is determined to make the most of this fragile new life.

1630264.title: A Special Memory
1630264.overview: The illness challenges the couple's love in a way they never anticipated, shifting the narrative from a sweet romance to an emotional journey.
1630264.trailerName: A Special Memory Official Trailer | Bela Padilla, Carlo Aquino

1630968.title: Evolver 62
1630968.overview: Globally-renowned historian Mark Lewisohn weaves an array of short, sharp stories into a savvy and surprising reveal of a band that's remained both cutting-edge and massively popular. Drawing from his extraordinary archive, Lewisohn zips through a galaxy of real lives and times, weaving curated artifacts into an entertaining narrative. Celebrating The Beatles' seminal year — 1962, the year that changed everything — the film explores the band's evolution through the very places and artifacts that shaped their story. Extending his celebrated stage show, Lewisohn takes the camera out of the theatre and onto the streets of Liverpool and London, to the sites where history unfolded. A compelling, surprising, and unmissable treat, EVOLVER:62 delivers unique viewing for Beatles fans, music lovers, and anyone curious about the moments that reshaped modern culture.

1636792.title: PARANOIA
1636792.overview: In a series of recent home invasions, a teenage girl must fight her delusive suspicions when she is left home alone.

1638776.title: Till We Meet Again on the Starry Hill
1638776.overview: Yuri, a high school teacher, lives her busy days carrying a sacred "vow" in her heart: to fulfill the dream of the one she loved, Akira, who aspired to be a teacher but perished in the flames of war. One day, a temporary teacher named Ryo appears. Yuri finds herself constantly seeing traces of Akira in Ryo's casual gestures and words. Though confused by her wavering heart, she desperately tries to suppress her feelings for him, having resolved to love only Akira for the rest of her life.
1638776.trailerName: 映画『あの星が降る丘で、君とまた出会いたい。』主題歌予告【8.7(fri)公開】

1645368.title: Forsaken
1645368.overview: Everyone knows the name of Samuel Paty, but few people really know his story. On October 16, 2020, Samuel Paty, professor of History-Geography, was murdered at the end of his college. In the light of investigations and trials, this film looks back on his last eleven days, and the gear that led to his tragic death.

1654648.overview: Aurelia, a self-destructive yet charming woman in the twilight of her life, returns to the dilapidated beachfront hotel where she used to vacation with her family in the 1970s. Half a century later, its deserted hallways, empty pool, and haunting coastline become the setting where she must finally confront the echoes of her past.

1654776.title: A City in the Forest
1654776.overview: When a private police foundation in Atlanta tries to raze an urban forest to build the country’s largest police training facility, a diverse, decentralized, and intersectional movement defends the forest from what they call “Cop City.” A City in the Forest paints a collective portrait of the country’s most urgent social justice story, where a web of activists fight back against environmental racism, political corruption, police violence, and the criminalization of dissent.

1655096.title: Love Letter to Texas
1655096.overview: A cinematic tribute to the spirit and landscape of Texas, following a lone character who travels across its vast terrain in search of a life that better fits who he is.

1655544.title: Act One
1655544.overview: A young aspiring actress, desperate for guidance and belonging, falls under the spell of a manipulative acting coach who draws her into a web of control and obsession.

1656632.title: Jerry West: The Logo
1656632.overview: He built dynasties, broke barriers, and became the silhouette that defines the game. But beneath Jerry West's legendary NBA legacy was a man haunted by perfection and pain. Through rare interviews with family and basketball icons, uncover the complex truth behind The Logo.

1657464.title: The Great Punjab Robbery
1657464.overview: Three robbers with strange names seize an ordinary bank in Punjab. No demands. No ransom. Just cryptic riddles sent to the cops, each one leading deeper into the mystery.
1657464.trailerName: The Great Punjab Robbery - Official Trailer | Raj Kundra | New Punjabi Movie | In Cinemas 7th August

1662776.title: Hearing
1662776.overview: Ninh lives with his mother and misses his ex-wife Ngoc and their young children. In his work as a mechanic who installs decibel meters in public spaces and homes, Ninh observes the silence that haunts relationships. Wishing for his parents, who live apart and do not speak to each other, to reconcile, his fear of losing connection to his loved ones forces Ninh to face life’s unpredictable rhythms.

1664760.title: Possessed
1664760.overview: Nut, a young nurse, returns to her hometown to care for her recovering mother, but she encounters a terrifying case that involves Mac, a boy who is believed to be possessed.
1664760.trailerName: official trailer ผีเข้า

1665464.title: Whispers Next Door
1665464.overview: Suzanne hides her daughter’s shocking secret to protect their family, but when their charismatic Pastor takes a disturbing interest in the baby, their lies ignite a chilling battle between faith, control, and truth.

1668344.title: Skin One Size Smaller
1668344.overview: Nikola has a dysfunctional relationship with his father, who wants the power to control his life.

1671608.title: Demonic Plastic Surgery
1671608.overview: When beauty becomes an obsession, Thanh takes a job at a remote cosmetic clinic to save her comatose lover. But the place soon turns into a nightmare, filled with dark rituals, wandering spirits, and a horrifying secret hidden beneath its glamorous facade. Drawn into the sinister “spirit binding” ritual, Thanh must face a life-or-death choice: remain in the underworld with the one she loves, or fight to escape the grip of a malevolent force.

1676472.title: Guggi
1676472.overview: An intimate portrait of abstract painter Guggi that traces his journey from humble Irish beginnings—with friends Bono and Gavin Friday—through his post-punk phase and toward international acclaim as an uncompromising artist.

1683000.title: Tokyo Nightfall
1683000.overview: A young man named Amenashi is haunted by the death of his younger sister Anna, who took her own life after witnessing a classmate’s suicide in high school. Burdened by guilt, he continues to chase her memory. One night, he learns of a secret mass suicide event held in a Tokyo nightclub and is drawn to it. His close friends, Nozu and Hattori, grow suspicious and follow him inside. In a closed-off space filled with despairing youths, the three attempt to escape, but are ultimately forced to confront the emotions they have each been carrying deep within.

1684408.title: We, the Hated
1684408.overview: An intimate portrait of Just Stop Oil protestors asks what it really costs to take a stand in a supposedly democratic society.

1686904.title: 13 Souls
1686904.overview: Following her mother’s death, fifteen-year-old Agne moves in with her estranged father and older sister near a cemetery where he works. There, she uncovers a mysterious and deadly connection between her family and the “13 Souls” — victims of a tragic, unsolved fire decades earlier. As the past resurfaces and strange phenomena escalate, Agne finds herself entangled in a supernatural mystery tied to possession, reincarnation, and long-buried guilt.

1687160.title: Bewildered
1687160.overview: Set in 1977, "Bewildered" follows Terry Perkins, a young, small-town girl who enters a hit game show for the chance to win $5,000 in hopes of saving her sick father, only to discover the charismatic host leads a cannibalistic cult!

1687928.title: The Flood: End of Mankind
1687928.overview: Three days before the great flood, Noah races against time to warn others of God's impending judgment on all mankind.
1687928.trailerName: NEW TRAILER - 'THE FLOOD: END OF MANKIND'. In Theaters Nationwide October 2026.

1688632.title: Dua Nafas
1688632.overview: Anto was entrusted to his grandmother in the village, grew up to become a successful doctor, and then returned to make her proud—only to find that his grandmother had died while waiting for him.

1689272.title: Chasing Utopia
1689272.overview: Chasing Utopia is a feature documentary asking the question everyone should be asking: will AI be humanity's greatest achievement or its greatest downfall? Mo Gawdat spent two years travelling the world - from Shanghai to Riyadh, New York to London - to find out, engaging with the leading minds shaping our future including Yoshua Bengio, Fei-Fei Li, Geoffrey Hinton, Max Tegmark, Elon Musk and Sam Altman. The result is a film that might change the way you see everything
1689272.trailerName: Chasing Utopia with Mo Gawdat - Trailer

1689976.title: Pentacide
1689976.overview: In 1999, a series of grisly, religiously inspired killings struck the country repeating every five years, now in the present day (2024) the story follows two detectives who are trying to solve the biggest serial killer case the UK has ever seen!

1690296.title: Satoko Always
1690296.overview: Satoko is a 15-year-old junior high school student. After a brief encounter with herclassmate Hayase at the ENT clinic, she begins to write a story sparked by herfeelings for him. Satoko is a 35-year-old working at a film publicity company. After being stabbed bythe wife of her married lover and hospitalized, she starts writing a story. Satoko is a 55-year-old housewife. On the last day of making lunchboxes for herthree sons, she remembers her childhood dream of becoming a writer and beginsto write.

1690936.title: Maishafko Mohani
1690936.overview: Maishafko Mohani is a romantic musical story about a Dangali prince and a beautiful Rukum princess. One night, the prince dreams of meeting his dream princess at the enchanting Godawari Park in Lalitpur. As he approaches her, they share a magical connection filled with joy, romance, and beautiful dance moments. In his dream, the prince expresses his admiration for her beauty, grace, and charming personality. As their bond grows stronger, he proposes marriage to her, and she happily accepts his proposal. Together, they celebrate their love through playful moments, romantic dances, and heartfelt expressions. The song takes viewers on a dreamy journey where love feels limitless and reality fades away. Through colorful visuals, graceful performances, and romantic chemistry, Maishafko Mohani portrays the timeless fantasy of finding one’s perfect love. It is a beautiful dream of a prince who sees his beloved princess as the most beautiful woman in his world.

1691192.title: Operation Sindoor: A Nation's Resolve
1691192.overview: To commemorate the anniversary of Operation Sindoor, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh released a documentary film on Operation Sindoor . Iit talks about the nefarious designs of Pakistan over a period of time, against the innocent people of India, and India's national resolve to strike back with precision and accuracy without collateral damage. The whole nation approaches jointness, self-reliance, and indigenisation, ensuring victory. It projects a shining example of political will and integration of forces
1691192.trailerName: Teaser of a special movie on Op Sindoor | Full movie, dropping soon!

1691768.title: The Witch of Yerasah (Dark Moon)
1691768.overview: Before the time we know, in a world where ancient secrets and supernatural forces reign, the legend of the Witch of Yerasah emerges. Part of the epic Dark Moon saga, this new animation delves into the journey of characters who fight against destiny and unseen forces that attempt to shape their future. Between unbreakable bonds and the awakening of ancestral powers, follow a thrilling story full of mystery, where every choice can change the course of an already dark universe. Prepare to discover the origins, sacrifices, and magic that connect the stars and blood.
1691768.trailerName: &TEAM 'Bewitched' Official MV Teaser | 'The Witch of Yerasah' Animated Film Teaser

1692664.title: Naissances
1692664.overview: Two friends chat over a hot tea.

1694008.title: Аэропорт
1694008.overview: Nine passengers on the Perm-Antalya flight find themselves locked in the airport's border control zone. It appears that they were gathered there for a reason.

1695864.title: PULSE
1695864.overview: In the world of ego, money, and fashion, a creative on the fringes of the music scene is torn between family and his ambition, leaving him to decide whether to betray his brother to achieve success.

1697080.title: Morning Afternoon Night
1697080.overview: They say you can start over, but if the music in your head is different, and the smells aren’t the same...then what? Where is that start?  In a single day, Marta, a young Russian migrant in Perth faces the end of her visa and the question of who she really is when home is nowhere to be found.

1698040.title: Paralysis
1698040.overview: During a terrifying episode of sleep paralysis, Natasha finds herself trapped in a world where time stops, her body betrays her, and a grotesque entity crawls closer, turning her struggle to wake into a desperate fight for spiritual survival.

1698104.title: AORTA
1698104.overview: Late night house parties with friends who can't understand and ephemeral conversations with an unnaturally familiar face.  AORTA is a film of teenage identity, discovery, emptiness and the hope for a future not yet lived.

1698488.title: Never Had a Chance
1698488.overview: When Ravi meets Sukhi, he wants to settle down and have a 'normal' life. But his best mate Jay has other plans and soon he's dragged back to the reality of the streets.

1698808.title: Ensaio Geral Para Um Futuro Ausente

1699832.title: Serve
1699832.overview: Generation Z has swiped away the old illusion-based structure of society and moves through a city whose surfaces simultaneously reflect desire, labour and visibility. »To serve« becomes an invitation to perform and to consider the cost of becoming visible. In the social choreographies of the film, femme bodies perform a Delulu script, glowing through the urban canyons of New York that reveals itself as a bygone hypercapitalist fiction. Yet they still invent their own grammar of desire.

1700920.title: FUN
1700920.overview: A 10-year-old boy encounters two teenage bullies with his pet rabbit on his way home from school. He needs to think of an escape plan while the two teens confront him with sinister games and an impossible choice.

1706616.title: Expert Marksmanship: A Path to Olympic Gold Medal
1706616.overview: This 1962 unclassified documentary short features footage of Captain W. W. McMillan's marksmanship skills, and his "Path to Olympic Gold Medal" at the 1960 Olympics.  While depicting Marines caring for rifles and practicing marksmanship at large shooting ranges, the majority of the film focuses on an interview of McMillan, where he provides marksmanship instruction and demonstrates each step, focusing on fundamentals like grip, stance, stability, sighting alignment and trigger control for rapid fire shooting with pistols and revolvers.  The film also features footage of McMillan at the Olympics and multiple creative "trick shots" by McMillan: teacups, poker chips, playing cards, upside down pistol shots and slight aligning with mirrors.

1707064.title: Crossed Animals
1707064.overview: Cindy didn't come to this island to make friends. She's here to get filthy rich — no matter the cost.

1707128.title: Europiano (1/2) - The finest piano concertos from across Europe
1707128.overview: To mark Music Day, ten European orchestras will perform some of the finest piano concertos alongside prestigious soloists and under the baton of renowned conductors from various cities across the continent. The programme for this exceptional concert features works by Brahms, Grieg, Chopin, Beethoven, Ravel and Mozart.

1708600.title: Diary of the Future
1708600.overview: To be fifteen, armed with a MiniDV camera, filming one’s adolescence in the 2000s in order to rediscover it later: friends, desires, holidays… Twenty years on, the tapes are unearthed and the diary rewritten in the future perfect, with all the fervour and tenderness of that time.

1708920.title: Six Days To Pay
1708920.overview: After Eddie Wayne gets into debt from a notorious gang, he has six days to pay his debt or he gets killed.
1708920.trailerName: Six Days To Pay - The Final Trailer (Official)

1710008.title: Nothing to Lose
1710008.overview: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at  nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

1710392.title: Gun Pilots
1710392.overview: Gun Pilots takes a compelling insider’s view into the rigorous world of U.S. Army Apache flight training. It follows student aviators as they confront the formidable challenge of mastering the AH-64 Apache—the most lethal attack helicopter ever built!

1711224.title: CatVideoFest 2026
1711224.overview: Our fuzzy overlords return to the big screen! Each year, CatVideoFest curates a compilation reel of the latest, best cat videos culled from countless hours of unique submissions and sourced animations, music videos, and, of course, classic internet powerhouses (Keyboard Cat, we’re looking at you).
1711224.trailerName: CatVideoFest 2026 - Official Trailer - Oscilloscope Laboratories HD

1713016.title: P$RN STAR University
1713016.overview: What happens when one of OnlyFans’ biggest stars decides to open a university? Andy Lee is breaking taboos and building a business, one straight guy at a time. With fifteen years in the adult industry behind him, he’s now doing something nobody else has attempted: launching a real-life school for aspiring male performers, coaching, coaxing and filming straight-identifying men as they step into gay adult content for the first time. His new intake arrives with different motivations, quick cash, curiosity, ambition, or all three. What none of them expect is quite how much they’re about to learn, about performance, yes, but also about boundaries, identity and the surprisingly emotional experience of being truly seen.

1715064.title: Sonatax
1715064.overview: Vasco, a young pianist, spends entire nights practicing after a mysterious musician shows him his true potential. His world changes as the piano consumes more and more of his life.

1715192.title: Evelyn
1715192.overview: As the main caretaker of her alcoholic father, a young woman experiences doubts as she prepares to leave her stagnant life behind for a boyfriend she may not fully trust. Based on "Eveline" by James Joyce.

1715832.title: Despondency
1715832.overview: A high school girl drifts through the same quiet routine every day. As time passes, her world grows smaller and more isolated, revealing the weight of her depression. Struggling with loneliness, she finds herself stuck in a cycle that makes each day feel the same as the last.

1716344.title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 5
1716344.overview: The fifth night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on July 4, 2026, at Yamagata Big Wing in Yamagata, Japan.

1717304.title: Ara què faig, amb això?
1717304.overview: A man buys a table from a woman. Little did he know this simple exchange would end up being more complicated.

1718520.title: Lowercase G
1718520.overview: This is a story about a crisis of faith, perpetuated by a holy sinner. This is a story about communion wafers that taste like cardboard, and prayers that feel like pantomimes. This is a story about something wholly unholy.

1720056.title: Crystal Blue
1720056.overview: An assassin becomes entangled with a relaxed crime boss and a paranoid drug runner.

1720632.title: Light Through The Dust
1720632.overview: When the 2011 Christchurch earthquake struck, tattoo apprentice Bonnie Singh was inside Southern Ink, the studio where she had finally begun chasing her dream. The tattoo studio collapsed and Bonnie, trapped in the rubble, suffered a broken back, a shattered neck, and a brain injury that would affect her for life.  With the help of fellow tattooist Jak Law, Bonnie is determined to push through physical and neurological limitations to master the craft of tattooing that once seemed out of reach. A story of resilience, reinvention, and the invisible scars we carry, this is not just a film about tattoos but instead is about what it means to rebuild a life and the importance of having a dream when everything has fallen away.
1720632.trailerName: Light Through The Dust OFFICIAL TRAILER

1721528.title: Canada Day
1721528.overview: At a dive bar on Canada Day, a 21-year-old named Aria sparks a romantic connection with the very actress she caused to be cancelled for 6 years prior.

1721592.title: Shroomery
1721592.overview: Tired and overworked, Lacey comes home to discover her boyfriend Miles has not only neglected to clean the apartment, he's left a disturbing surprise in the refrigerator: rapidly growing "shrooms" that he acquired from a sketchy janitor. The couple's initial curiosity leads to terror as the mushrooms take over their kitchen, minds, and ultimately bodies.

1722808.title: I Love You Where the Sunny Days Are
1722808.overview: Mati leaves the country to meet Julia, her girlfriend, who currently lives in a distant and cold place. There, they face a lack of identity and the impossibility of returning home.

1723064.title: Drawn Together
1723064.overview: Marfil Cortés, daughter of a Spanish business tycoon, sees her perfect New York life shattered when she’s suddenly kidnapped and mysteriously released. As a result, her father assigns the enigmatic Sebastian Moore as her bodyguard.

1723384.title: Southern Fuel
1723384.overview: Across the American South, gas stations are more than pit stops. They are places to eat, gather, and share stories. Photographer Kate Medley explores how these everyday spaces sustain rural communities in North Carolina.

1723448.title: Himalaya: Black Ice Edition
1723448.overview: FOUND Exclusive B&W Edition: Cryptozoologist Yuma Sato enters a newly discovered Himalayan ice cave to search for the mythical "Snow Ghost." Broadcasting live, his camera reveals shocking finds. Is it an internet hoax or a major scientific breakthrough?

1724088.title: Drop Your Cat
1724088.overview: An elderly mother in her twilight years grows weary of her identity as a mother. She crosses paths with a troubled young man, and is also haunted by the ghost of her late husband. This sets off a wandering journey across Beijing, under the pretext of abandoning her cat. She lingers like a specter, awkwardly observing and faintly stepping into the distant, disconnected lives of her son, daughter-in-law and friends. Unforeseen incidents arise, their lives collide and intertwine, and amid this constant movement, she rediscovers the vital force of her true self.

1725048.title: Attack on Paradise
1725048.overview: After seven years in prison, Suleyman is released and determined to pick up his life again. During his incarceration, his home, the flat block ‘Paradise’, has been taken over by gangs and drug dealers. When the police decide to raid Paradise, Suleyman gets caught in the violence, with only one goal: to get back to his mother and get her to safety. Alongside rookie police officer Yasmine, Suleyman battles his way up, floor by floor.

1726776.title: 3rd FLOOR
1726776.overview: A routine elevator ride becomes a battlefield when Maya Uche, a Black activist, and Brett Kiminski, a white conservative, are trapped together between floors. With nowhere to run, their assumptions, anger, and buried grief rise to the surface, forcing both strangers to face the truth behind their politics — and the pain that made them who they are.

1726840.title: Descendants: Hidden Heroes
1726840.overview: The sixth installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

1727096.title: yellow orange green blue red cut
1727096.overview: yellow bellow can you get me to orange so i can see green but that won't do because i still need to smell blue and that can't be too far from red.

1727352.title: The Two Year Rule
1727352.overview: On the way to a cottage weekend with friends, a couple’s drive takes an unexpected turn when a passing cemetery stirs unresolved tensions.

1727800.title: Nocaretown
1727800.overview: In the surreal town of Nocaretown, a group of bizarre characters become entangled in a dangerous, absurd quest centered on a mysterious wooden box.

1728056.title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
1728056.overview: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

1728696.title: Manhunt
1728696.overview: Inspired by the real 2019 Northern British Columbia manhunt when two teenage boys from Vancouver Island murdered three strangers and fled north through ghost towns and endless forest. Their flight, live-tracked across social media and news feeds, unfolded like a fever dream of the digital age: an openworld simulation of fear and fascination. Weeks later, their bodies were found by a river, the chase ending as abruptly as it began.

1730168.title: Unstoppable
1730168.overview: Upcoming short film from Katharine Rogers in collaboration with Bus Stop Films participants.

1733048.title: Last Viewing
1733048.overview: A sleazy film director hires out a ramshackle cinema to screen his forgotten masterpiece, only for the film to be haunted.

1733560.title: When We Talk About Grape What We Talk About
1733560.overview: Late at night, a rideshare driver picks up a passenger and realizes she is his former lover. As the car moves through the city, silence and buried memories surface. In the short ride ahead, they must face what was left unsaid—and the lives they never had together.

1735096.title: West/East
1735096.overview: We follow Russian inhabitants of Estonia as they travel to Russia. Their crossing of the border takes them through a geographical space marked by tensions between two ethnic groups, while the Russian-Ukrainian war reignites old fears.

1737208.title: Weedkiller
1737208.overview: Weedkiller is a Welsh B-movie and indie SOV horror feature written and directed by filmmaker Tom Hughes. The film follows a humble gardener who goes on a violent rampage to rescue his beloved plants after a gang hijacks his allotment. The movie, described as a genre banger packed with chaos and attitude, draws inspiration from campy classics like The Toxic Avenger.

1737272.title: Wake Me Up
1737272.overview: 1 year after the murder of Jessica Young's older sister Audrey a second killer appears. Killing left right and centre across the island of Guernsey. To do what the police cannot do Jessica Young and her best friend Delilah must face up to killer to prevent their own deaths and free Guernsey from the Murderer's tyranny.

1739832.title: Middle Class
1739832.overview: Set in a former train factory turned art gallery in Milan, Italy, Classe Media explores the contradictions of being a working class artist. This documentary short follows the filmmaker as they question their class position as an unemployed artist in residence in this former working class space.

1739960.title: Jared Leto: Hollywood's Dark Secret
1739960.overview: An investigative documentary exploring long-standing and newly detailed allegations of sexual misconduct, grooming, and criminal sexual conduct against Oscar-winning actor and Thirty Seconds to Mars frontman Jared Leto.

1740088.title: Sins of Kujo
1740088.overview: Kujo (Yuya Yagira) continues to live under a tent on a building rooftop, taking on anyone who seeks his help, including those from the criminal underworld.  Although they have separate ways, Kujo's former partner, Karasuma (Hokuto Matsumura), is drawn back into his life as the two become caught between a violent underworld conflict and an escalating police and prosecutorial crackdown.
1740088.trailerName: 『映画 九条の大罪』ティザー映像 ≪2027年1月8日(金)公開≫

1740280.title: Четыре жизни Петра Мамонова
1740280.overview: A documentary about the Soviet and Russian musician, singer, actor, director, poet, and translator Pyotr Mamonov.

1741752.title: Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity VS Raiya
1741752.overview: Seeking the truth behind the "Biscatonic Cluster  Incident", which claimed an unprecedented number of victims and turned Death Gavan evil, Gavan Infinity —Reiji Doki— sets out for Planet Alkam, one of the planets where the incident took place. There, Gavan Raiya —Kunai Kazanami— who was tracking Death Gavan’s whereabouts, also appears from across dimensions…
1741752.trailerName: 『超ギャバン』消えた怜慈…デス・ギャバン闇堕ちの真相が明らかに　Vシネクスト『超宇宙刑事ギャバン インフィニティVSライヤ』特報

1742712.title: Vado in America
1742712.overview: A documentary and investigative essay on the traces of migration, family memory, and the audiovisual archive connecting the experience between Switzerland and Argentina.

1743480.title: ST☆R (Stella Marie's Superstar Lookalike)
1743480.overview: An obsessed fan literally grafts their idol's standee onto their own skin, only to find their truest self in the friend who stayed to watch them fall apart.

1744056.title: Gail
1744056.overview: A superfan of the Canadian band Our Lady Peace follows them on their 30th anniversary tour across Canada.

1744568.title: Bloom
1744568.overview: When Lily inherits her great aunt's struggling desert nursery, she devotes herself to bringing it back to life. As her garden flourishes, her need to sustain it becomes something she can no longer control.

1744632.title: The King of Cannabis
1744632.overview: Inspired by true events, this crime drama follows the rise of Terrence "Tee" Jackson as he builds a drug empire.
1744632.trailerName: The King of Cannabis | Official Trailer | Luis Guzmán, Charles Malik Whitfield | High Times

1745144.title: Всплеск
1745144.overview: Lilya and Tema are lying in a tent by the river. Lilya hears a splash and asks Tema to check if anyone is outside. There's no one around—it seems Lilya was mistaken.

1747064.title: El Pintor de los Milagros
1747064.overview: After an accident leaves his daughter in a coma, Francisco, a seasoned journalist, tries to rebuild his life by accepting a seemingly minor assignment: uncovering the origins of the ancient mural of the Black Christ, venerated by millions. His search leads him to Santiago, who reveals the untold story of the image's mysterious creator: a young man enslaved in 17th-century Peru, known only as "The Painter." Amid discrimination and suffering, the young man transforms his pain into an extraordinary work: a Black Christ that, over the centuries, would become the most important symbol of faith in our nation and one of the most venerated in the world. As he reconstructs this story of hope, resilience, and redemption, Francisco embarks on a journey that will forever change his understanding of faith and restore his belief that miracles are still possible.

1747576.title: A Stolen Movie
1747576.overview: Camilo Restrepo reappropriates and remixes a real General Motors promotional film depicting an early-1960s exhibition across the Darién Gap in Chevrolet Corvairs. As the representatives of the global North’s industrial might bridge the same chasm that stands between today’s migrants and the United States, Restrepo considers the unequal flows of people and property between the Americas.

1748664.title: Captain Newfoundland
1748664.overview: Media mogul, athlete, creator of the psychedelic superhero Captain Newfoundland, and an activist against his home province joining Confederation: Geoff Stirling was all these things and more. To do justice to a character as complex as this film’s protagonist, Mike Feehan turns the camera on himself and his co-director Jamie Miller as they weave together archival footage, animation, and fantastical recreations from Stirling's experimental 1970s late-night TV show, all very in keeping with NTV's original broadcast mission. Captain Newfoundland is an illuminating and wildly entertaining portrait of a complex man and his impact on the province that, according to Stirling, may or may not be the tip of the long-lost island of Atlantis.

1752312.title: Papi Ricky: La Película
1752312.overview: Alicia returns to Chile to introduce her future husband, an eccentric young Spanish hipster who embodies modernity. His arrival causes a family upheaval, and the clash with the conservative Papi Ricky and the irreverent Catrala leads both parents to put aside their old differences and unite around a common goal: stopping their daughter’s wedding.

1758392.title: The Cameras at Palmer Building
1758392.overview: Something strange is happening in the hallways of an ordinary apartment building.

1762040.title: Strays
1762040.overview: Orestis, in his early thirties, is a conscientious objector facing the loss of his family home due to fines imposed for refusing military service. As the pressure mounts, he finds himself torn between his principles, his relationship with his father, and his responsibility towards his friends.
